headline: Latin American Annual Energy Inflation Accelerates to 8.33% in August
summary: According to an OLADE report, annual energy inflation across Latin America and the Caribbean reached 8.33% in August, hitting a 12-month high amid continued fuel price pressures.
why: Higher regional energy inflation weighs on household purchasing power and increases operating costs for local transportation and industrial sectors.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Accelerating fuel and diesel costs drive up input prices across regional supply chains.
